attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9, no package available, installed from upstream binary release), opened firewalld ports 2379/2380, and loaded application keys under /app/*. Simulated permanent, unrecoverable loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and wiping its data directory, then confirmed node1/node2 retained quorum with keys still readable. Removed the dead member (be0a6550ae746ae3) via etcdctl, added a new member for node3 (be6219fd849d98d6) with initial-cluster-state=existing, and started fresh etcd there — it synced automatically and all application keys (db_host, feature_flag, requests) reappeared intact. Final cluster: 3 healthy members, single leader (node1), fully synced raft indices. Then ran the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id + etcd health baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted each one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and verified full cluster health/quorum/data integrity after each restart before moving to the next node.
